name: DontZcare
summary:
DontZcare is a thrilling VR horror experience that throws you into an endless maze of shifting backrooms where every corner hides both mystery and danger. Trapped in a surreal world, your only goal is to survive and escape while being relentlessly hunted by bizarre creatures—most notably the unsettling “Scary Baboon” whose deceptively goofy faces mask their true menace.
